title: Heliocot: an open, reproducible segmentation-to-PLA workflow for cotton canopy orientation dynamics
description: Heliocot is an open, reproducible segmentation-to-PLA workflow for top-down field RGB images of cotton. It converts instance segmentation masks into reference-area standardized projected leaf area (PLA) time series and supports quantifying diurnal canopy orientation dynamics.
notes: This repository hosts the workflow code and documentation. Large research assets (images/annotations/derived outputs) are archived separately on Zenodo (DOI: TBA).
